newsitem.title: USA: NASD names Frank Zarb as new president and CEO.
newsitem.headline: NASD names Frank Zarb as new president and CEO.

text.p: The National Association of Securities Dealers Tuesday named Frank Zarb, former chairman of the New York insurance firm Alexander and Alexander Services Inc., its new president and chief executive officer.
Zarb, who assumes his new duties on Feb. 24, succeeds Joseph Hardiman, who is retiring on Jan. 31. Hardiman served nearly 10 years with the self-regulatory group that runs the Nasdaq stock market.
In a teleconference call from Pebble Beach, Calif., Zarb told reporters "the whole notion of self-regulation is a vital ingrediant to the market place.
"What's important is that we end up with the kind of regulatory system that gets the job done and does it without redundancies," he said.

The selection of Zarb ended a search that began in early July when a committee was formed and chaired by Daniel Tully, NASD chairman of the board of governors and chairman and chief executive officer of Merrill Lynch & Co Inc.
Zarb will also remain chairman of the Long Island Power Authority, overseeing the proposed $4 billion merger between Brooklyn Union Gas and Long Island Lighting Co.
NASD is the parent company of the Nasdaq stock market and National Association of Securities Dealers Regulatory (NSADR), the enforcement arm for the entire brokage industry.
